description: parseEntraPhoneValue table: ;ext= (with padding, any case), ext, ext., x<digits>, vanity numbers unchanged, plain numbers unchanged, over-long or non-digit extension dropped with discardedExtension, empty phone part returned unparsed.

buildEntraContactPhoneNumbers: no-extension values produce exactly today's rows; extension values set extension; invalid values skipped with notices and the default moves; every returned row passes ContactModel.validatePhoneNumbers.
checkContactPhoneNumberValue returns the pre-move messages; validatePhoneNumbers still rejects '+14165551234;ext=228' as unsupported characters.

executeEntraSync (mocked): a create, link or match failure for one of three users records one failure issue with the right stage, increments failed only, processes the remaining users, still runs inactivation, and resolves; a post-write portal failure carries contactNameId.
executeEntraSync (mocked): a created user with an over-long extension yields one phone_numbers notice and failed === 0.
Reconciler: a phone row differing only in extension is detected as changed by the real run and the preview.
Aggregator, serializer and recordSyncTenantResultWithDb: failed counter, failed/userIssues round-trip, failed_count and user_issues written and capped at 100.
UI: history panel and console last-run show 'N contacts failed' and failure entries only when failed > 0; completed + failed > 0 is a warning outcome.

Integration (real DB): '+14165551234;ext=228' creates a contact row with phone_number '+14165551234' and extension '228'; re-sync of the linked contact does not throw or count as updated; changed extension counts as updated; a user without email/UPN between two good users leaves both good contacts created and failed === 1.
